item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Judge sends Charlie Kirk murder case to trial with defendant facing potential death penalty
item.description: PROVO, Utah (AP) — The murder case against the Utah man accused of assassinating conservative activist Charlie Kirk last year is headed for trial, and the defendant could face the death penalty if he’s convicted. Utah District Judge Tony Graf on Tuesday sided with prosecutors who said they had “overwhelming” evidence that suspect Tyler Robinson [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Tiger Woods plans to change not guilty plea in DUI case in Florida, court documents show
item.description: STUART, Fla. (AP) — Tiger Woods plans to change his not guilty plea in a DUI case stemming from a rollover crash in Florida, according to court documents filed Tuesday. In March, Woods' Land Rover clipped a truck, rolled onto its side and the legendary golfer was arrested, officials said. Woods pleaded not guilty to [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco County physician suffers widowmaker heart attack at age 44
item.description: Dr. Monicka Felix is an internal medicine doctor at HCA Florida Trinity Hospital. She was reunited with the medical team who saved her life nearly two years ago.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts Democratic primary over opponent who called for change
item.description: U.S. Sen. Ed Markey of Massachusetts secured the Democratic nomination in his bid for a third term in office Tuesday, fighting off a challenger who argued that it was time for a generational change.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge rules Charlie Kirk murder suspect should stand trial, may face death penalty
item.description: Nearly one year after conservative activist Charlie Kirk was gunned down during a college event in front of thousands of people, a judge ruled Tuesday night the suspected killer should stand trial.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Sci-Fi feature 'The Last Earthling' begins filming in St. Pete using virtual production in studio
item.description: A new futuristic sci-fi feature film has officially kicked off production in St. Petersburg, bringing advanced filmmaking technology and local economic investment to the Tampa Bay Area.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Bay area veteran leads 'Alive Ride' through Pinellas Park on 20th anniversary of survival
item.description: Roughly 100 bicyclists took to the streets with a police escort Tuesday morning, riding 11 miles through Pinellas Park.

[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Supply chain expert discusses the causes of the U.S. Canada tariff troubles
item.description: U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods are impacting the price of many items, including steel and lumber. Canada is the United States’ second-largest trading partner.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] MLB's Los Angeles Angels to be sold to Rams and Arsenal owner Stan Kroenke
item.description: Kroenke Sports and Entertainment has agreed to purchase controlling ownership of the Los Angeles Angels from Arte Moreno in a deal expected to close in early 2027.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Zephyrhills police reopen cold case of man missing since 2007, ask public for help
item.description: Zephyrhills police are asking for the public's help solving the nearly 20-year-old disappearance of Carlton McCarthy Ireland.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] A startup in California is renting out humanoid robots to clean your home
item.description: Tau Robotics is charging $30 an hour for the service and these robots can vacuum floors, wipe down kitchen counters and even take out the trash.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Developer withdraws proposal for 150-home Kathleen subdivision
item.description: A proposed 150-home subdivision in Kathleen is off the table at least for now, after the developer withdrew its application Tuesday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] South Tampa flooding fix: City and SoHo Business Alliance clash over best solution
item.description: The SoHo Business Alliance is challenging Tampa's South Howard flood relief plan, citing costs, construction impacts, and flood prevention concerns.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pinellas Co. commissioner calls for removing Flock cameras from county roads
item.description: A Pinellas County commissioner is proposing the county remove automated license plate reader cameras from county roads and end agreements with Flock Safety and other providers, citing concerns about privacy and government surveillance.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Homeowners facing higher costs for a new roof
item.description: A New Port Richey homeowner received roof replacement estimates ranging from $15,000 to $36,000 as material, labor and transportation costs continue to push roofing prices higher nationwide.
